core: GPCR chemoattractant signalling in leukocyte migration
qualifier: G beta:gamma-PI3Kgamma and prostaglandin E input
name: GPCR chemoattractant signalling to leukocyte migration via Gbetagamma-PI3Kgamma
rationale: All members are G-protein-coupled chemoattractant signals (CXCR4, PGE, PLC/PKC, Cdc42) steering leukocyte homing and chemotaxis; unlike the chemokine and Rac/RHO confusables, the theme carries Gbetagamma-PI3Kgamma and prostaglandin E signalling.

qualifier: fucosylated Lewis blood group oligosaccharides
name: Fucose metabolism and Lewis antigen oligosaccharide synthesis
rationale: Members cover fucose metabolism and fucosylated oligosaccharide (Lewis antigen) synthesis, distinct from the N-glycan, O-glycan and sialylation confusables, with which it shares nothing.

qualifier: membrane architecture: cristae, outer membrane, fusion
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane architecture
rationale: Members concern targeting, import, processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins plus cristae, outer-membrane and fusion organization, unlike confusables centred on mitochondrial calcium uptake, inner-membrane insertion or respiratory chain assembly.

qualifier: sodium-coupled, renal proximal tubule
name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate and pyruvate transport, renal proximal tubule
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, tricarboxylates and pyruvate by sodium-coupled carboxylate transporters, with proximal tubule development; confusables instead cover organic cations, monocarboxylate/lactate or malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and cytokine output, MHC upregulation
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 polarisation and IFN-gamma production
rationale: All members promote Th1 immunity: dendritic cell IL-12/GM-CSF production, Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production and MHC upregulation; confusables are instead IFN-gamma receptor signalling, its negative regulation, or CD8/antigen presentation.

qualifier: type I hypersensitivity
name: FcepsilonRI-triggered calcium mobilization in type I hypersensitivity
rationale: All three members are IgE receptor (FcepsilonRI/LAT2) calcium signalling in type I hypersensitivity, unlike confusables on mast cell regulation, histamine/lipid GPCRs, BCR signalling or eosinophils.

qualifier: glycosphingolipid synthesis plus inherited CYP and transporter disorders
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis with inherited CYP and transporter disorders
rationale: A loose lipid-metabolism grouping of ganglioside/galactosylceramide synthesis and monogenic defects of cytochrome P450s (CYP7B1, CYP1B1, CYP2U1, TBXAS1) and transporters (SLCO2A1, SLC33A1, ABCB6); confusables centre on bile acid, eicosanoid, cholesterol or GPI-anchor metabolism.

core: Resting membrane potential and cation homeostasis
qualifier: two-pore K+ leak, KATP and Ca2+-activated K+ channels
name: K+ leak channels and cation gradients setting resting potential
rationale: Members are potassium channels (K2P families, KATP, KCa), P-type ATPases and Na+/K+/Mg2+ homeostasis maintaining membrane potential; confusables instead cover hair cell/micturition physiology, presynaptic potential, paracellular Mg2+ transport or cation-chloride cotransporters.

core: COPI vesicle trafficking at the Golgi
qualifier: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members span COPI-dependent intra-Golgi and Golgi-ER traffic and Golgi ribbon formation, mitotic disassembly/reassembly and positioning; confusables lack the structural organization and instead carry COPI-independent, endosome-to-Golgi or tubulation pathways.

qualifier: neuronal migration and brainstem respiratory control
name: Hindbrain and brainstem development with neuronal migration
rationale: All members concern hindbrain/pons/brainstem development, migration, branchiomotor axon guidance and brainstem respiratory control, distinguishing it from cranial nerve, cerebellar and spinal cord confusables.

qualifier: endonucleolytic cleavage of the tricistronic transcript
name: Pre-rRNA cleavage and processing in ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are ETS/ITS1/ITS2 cleavages and 5'-end processing of pre-rRNA with its positive regulation and MYC-driven nucleolar genes, while confusables centre on RNA polymerase I/III transcription.

qualifier: L1CAM-dependent axon tracts and cerebellum
name: L1-dependent axon tract and cerebellar development
rationale: Members are L1CAM signalling/recycling with commissural and corticospinal tract formation, collateral sprouting, cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia development and motor learning; the L1 and axon-tract members are what confusables on forebrain, dopaminergic or hindbrain development lack.

qualifier: elongation factor hypusine/diphthamide and hydroxylation
name: Elongation factor hypusination, diphthamidation and protein hydroxylation
rationale: Members are residue modifications: hypusine on eIF5A, diphthamide on eEF2, lysine/proline hydroxylation, supporting translation elongation; confusables instead carry methylation, tRNA modification or selenocysteine/toxin pathways.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated output: OAS, IFN-alpha response, IP-10
name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and interferon-stimulated antiviral response
rationale: Members link RIG-I/helicase and cytosolic DNA sensing via IRF3 to type I IFN and downstream OAS, IFN-alpha and IP-10 responses, the downstream effector side that RLR/NF-kB-focused confusables lack.

core: Non-coding RNA maturation and nuclear RNA surveillance
qualifier: Cajal body snoRNP and telomerase biogenesis
name: Cajal body snoRNP, telomerase and nuclear exosome RNA processing
rationale: Members cover snoRNP/scaRNA assembly and Cajal body localization, telomerase assembly and telomere extension, rRNA modification and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay; the telomerase and Cajal body members are absent from the transcription, RNA-modification and mRNA-decay confusables.

qualifier: mast cell activation and FcgammaR phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signalling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: All members are FcepsilonRI and FcgammaR signalling outputs: mast cell activation/degranulation, hypersensitivity, ADCC and Fc-mediated phagocytosis, distinct from BCR-centred confusables.

qualifier: G2/M transition and activated CD4 T cell proliferation
name: E2F-driven G2/M proliferation programme including activated CD4 T cells
rationale: Members are E2F/MYC cell-cycle transcription, G2/M transition and checkpoint events and proliferating CD4 T cell modules; confusables instead centre on RB-E2F G1/S control or replication origin licensing.

qualifier: neural, incretin and fatty-acid modulation
name: Neural, incretin and fatty-acid modulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are modulators of insulin and glucagon secretion by adrenaline, acetylcholine, GLP-1 and fatty acids, unlike confusables on beta-cell identity, insulin processing, incretin synthesis or KATP channels.

qualifier: reception, SMO activation and GLI transcription
name: Hedgehog reception, SMO activation and GLI transcription
rationale: All members are the receiving-cell Hedgehog pathway from ligand-receptor binding to SMO and GLI target transcription, distinct from confusables on Hh ligand processing and neural/axial patterning.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidised LDL, amyloid-beta; microglia
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, oxLDL and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members are scavenger receptor classes and phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells, immune complexes, oxidised lipoproteins (foam cells) and amyloid-beta, including microglial activation, which the hyaluronan/RAGE and lysosomal confusables lack.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing, deadenylation and decapping
name: mRNA 3'-end formation, histone mRNA processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members are cleavage/polyadenylation, Pol II termination, histone stem-loop mRNA processing, deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike confusables on ARE-binding stability, capping/splicing or NMD and export.

qualifier: dendritic cell, T, B, NK and mast cell migration
name: Chemokine receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis, especially dendritic cells
rationale: Members are chemokines and receptors (CXCR4, CCR7) and chemotaxis of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells; confusables instead centre on S1P/lymphoid organ development or integrin-mediated migration.

Mostly untitled BTM modules spanning mitochondrial housekeeping, chromatin/Polycomb, Pol II transcription, RB1/BCL2L1 survival, centrosomes, Ras GAP signalling and ubiquitination; no single biological theme is true of all members.

qualifier: neurodevelopmental: amygdala, MECP2 GABA regulation
name: Neurodevelopmental control of social and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members are social, visual, tactile and sensorimotor-gating behaviours with amygdala development and MECP2-regulated GABA genes, distinguishing it from vocal learning, locomotor/grooming and presynaptic confusables.

qualifier: FGF23-Klotho/PTH signalling; dentin and bone
name: FGF23-Klotho and PTH phosphate regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members link FGF23-Klotho, PTH and phosphate responses with bone mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption, unlike confusables on Na+/Pi transporters, enamel or ectopic calcification.
